scope: Sanitized documentation snapshot; no keys, endpoints or database identifiers.
translation_usage_scope: Translation operation only. Detection, OCR, vision and independent source validation are not covered by this aggregate. Zero recorded estimate in subscription mode is not a zero total bill.

recovered_run.limitation: Earlier recovery run; predates the latest layout changes. Not a cold-run benchmark or current throughput guarantee.

visual_review.method: Local production clean/render replay from saved real OCR and translations; no new provider request or publication.
